q: What year did Jurassic Park come out in theaters?
explain: 1993! Right at the top of your fact sheet.

q: How many minutes of dinosaurs are actually in this two-hour movie?
explain: Only 15 minutes! 9 minutes of robots and 6 of computer animation. The rest is people being scared. It is on your fact sheet.
John Hammond, the man who built the park, when the jeeps roll into the valley of dinosaurs.

q: Put the night everything went wrong in order.
items: Nedry shuts off the security fences
The tour cars stop in front of the T-rex paddock
The T-rex breaks through and attacks the cars
The raptors hunt Tim and Lex in the kitchen
explain: Nedry turns off the power, the cars die, the T-rex walks right through the fence, and the raptors come last.

q: Every dinosaur in the park was made female so they could not have babies.
explain: True. That was the plan. But the dinosaurs found a way, and Dr. Grant finds hatched eggs in the jungle.
Way. Dr. Malcolm says it, and the dinosaurs prove him right.

q: How do the scientists bring dinosaurs back to life?
options: Dinosaur DNA from mosquitoes trapped in amber
Frozen dinosaur eggs found under the ice
A time machine brings them from the past
explain: Mosquitoes bit dinosaurs, got stuck in tree sap, and the sap hardened into amber with the blood still inside.

q: Why is the cup of water on the jeep dashboard famous?
options: Its rippling rings warn that the T-rex is coming
Tim spills it on the radio and breaks it
It proves the jeep is out of gas
explain: Boom... boom... each T-rex footstep sends rings through the water. One of the most famous shots in movie history.

q: Where do Tim and Lex hide from the two raptors?
explain: The stainless-steel kitchen. Shiny counters, clattering spoons, and two very clever girls hunting.

q: Tap a burning torch on the big park gate.
explain: Hammond wanted the gate to feel like an adventure, so it burns with torches like an ancient temple.
